title: cymbopogon lepidus
intro: Cymbopogon lepidus, commonly known as East Indian Lemon Grass or Variegated Lemon Grass, is a type of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon lepidus include its sedative, antiseptic, and insecticidal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which contribute to its various health benefits.
